description: Paid: 0.001 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.001 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: What DNS records does this name return right now? Raw answers for the given FQDN and types (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA), plus resolver id, rcode, TTLs when available, query_ms and observed_at. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

name.description: FQDN to query (not an IP, not localhost/.local)

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

types.description: Comma-separated record types. Default A,AAAA. Allowed: A,AAAA,MX,TXT,NS,CNAME,SOA,CAA

name: dns_records
title: DNS record-set reading (paid: 0.001 RLUSD / 0.001 USDC on Base / 0.001 RLUSD on Base via x402)
